name: Curve-based Volumetric Free-Form Deformation
definition: A technique to deform a volumetric fire volume by constructing a lattice of curves around a central spline, allowing flexible shape manipulation while maintaining texture coordinates for rendering.
summary: Curve-based Volumetric Free-Form Deformation manipulates volumetric shapes using B-spline lattices, evaluating deformation on the CPU to enable real-time interactivity without GPU inverse parameterization.
